question: Which country held the presidency of the G7 and hosted the Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in March 2026, where India’s EAM Dr. S. Jaishankar participated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**France.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar visited France on March 26–27, 2026, to participate in the G7 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting at the invitation of the French Foreign Minister.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The meeting was held at Abbaye des-Vaux-de-Cernay, France, focusing on global governance reform and international crises.**
 
• Dr. Jaishankar advocated for **UN Security Council reforms** and highlighted challenges faced by the **Global South**, such as food and energy security.
 
• The G7 partners discussed de-escalation in the **Middle East** and continued support for **Ukraine** against Russia.
 
• G7 (Group of Seven)__
 __
 
• Members - Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, UK, USA, and the EU.
 
• 2026 Host - France.
 
• Invited Partners - India, Brazil, South Korea, Ukraine and Saudi Arabia.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Global South__

 __
 
• Definition - A term used to describe developing and least developed nations, primarily located in Africa, Asia, and Latin America.
 
 
 
• Shadow Fleet__
 __
 
• Context - Refers to aging tankers used to bypass international sanctions on oil exports; G7 aims to strengthen coordination against such vessels.
 
 
 
• Jean-Noël Barrot__
 
 
• Role - The Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs of France who extended the invitation to India.
